findings.description: test_support::temp_dir returned uncreated paths; callers had to create_dir_all manually
findings.disposition: fixed: renamed to unused_temp_path with non-existence contract; ALL created-workspace fixtures migrated to tempfile::tempdir() with owned cleanup; remaining 3 uses (validate_dangerous_project, output_defaults, output_overrides) are genuine uncreated-path contracts

findings.description: Hardcoded /tmp/ paths in test files
findings.disposition: fixed: all hardcoded /tmp/ paths removed and replaced with tempfile::tempdir() or unused_temp_path

findings.description: exists()/is_file()/is_dir() mask IO errors as absence
findings.disposition: fixed: test_fs helpers use symlink_metadata; all negative exists() assertions in build_orchestration_tests, build_cleanup_tests, check_tests, and cli_tests migrated to assert_path_missing; fixture discovery uses symlink_metadata with fail-closed on metadata errors

findings.description: Broad is_err()/error_count()>0 assertions accept wrong failure at multi-lane boundaries; String-only transport in integration fixture/expectation/runner forced substring error identity
findings.disposition: fixed: all 26 build_orchestration is_err() assertions migrated to assert_output_rejection; benchmark errors carry typed FrontendBenchmarkFailureKind + diagnostic_codes; fixture/expectation loading returns FixtureLoadError{kind,message} (Filesystem/Manifest/ExpectationParse/ExpectationContract/FixtureContract/PathBoundary); runner returns TestRunnerError with Options/SuitePolicy/InventoryReport/TriageReport/Selection/ThreadPool/Fixture kinds; negative self-tests assert error.kind; compile_project_frontend broad is_err() seeds made exact; containment test uses assert_output_rejection; busy benchmark test uses owned entry + TimingSession kind

findings.description: first_infrastructure_error_for_tests only returned the first infrastructure error
findings.disposition: fixed: infrastructure_errors_for_tests() iterator scans all error diagnostics

findings.description: WarningBuilder created StringId from fresh StringTable; CaseExecutionResult had impossible states
findings.disposition: fixed: WarningBuilder uses active string_table; CaseExecutionResult constructors removed from production; runner tests use panic_if_called; terse_reporting uses valid BuildResult and CompilerMessages in all synthetic fixtures

findings.description: CurrentDirGuard::Drop discarded restoration failures
findings.disposition: fixed: Option<PathBuf> take pattern prevents double-restore; finish() returns Result; Drop panics on restore failure (non-unwinding) or reports to stderr (unwinding); restore-failure injection seam; regression tests for both finish-error and unwind-report paths; obsolete test_restore seam removed in favor of finish() called directly under an injected restore that actually restores CWD then returns the synthetic error

findings.disposition: fixed: now requires exactly one error diagnostic overall, and that error must be the expected infrastructure type

findings.description: Integration fixture/expectation loading and runner harness failures travelled as String, forcing negative self-tests to match error identity by prose substrings (fragile; could match the fixture path)
findings.disposition: fixed: added FixtureLoadError{kind,message} (Filesystem/Manifest/ExpectationParse/ExpectationContract/FixtureContract/PathBoundary) across fixture.rs, expectations.rs, manifest.rs and golden discovery; added TestRunnerError with Options/SuitePolicy/InventoryReport/TriageReport/Selection/ThreadPool/Fixture kinds across run_all_test_cases/run_loaded_suite/options.validate/report persistence/selection/thread-pool/env parsing; migrated all negative self-tests in runner.rs, manifest.rs, expectations.rs, fixture.rs to assert error.kind while retaining message prose checks; CLI reads error.message for display

findings.description: find_output_file returned the first matching artifact and collect_built_artifact_paths accepted duplicate normalized paths, so every later assertion inspected one artifact of an ambiguous set
findings.disposition: fixed in Phase 4: BuiltArtifactIndex is built once in validate_success_result before any success assertion and consumed by the HTML/HTML-Wasm baselines, artifact assertions, absence checks, goldens and rendered-output harnesses; validity and collision identity come from the canonical output_path_identity used by the output writer, so the harness rejects exactly the destinations production rejects and folds ASCII case only; an ambiguous or invalid set fails the case as FailureKind::HarnessFailed; self-tests match the typed ArtifactIndexError variants (with one separate test owning the rendered wording) and cover duplicates, ASCII case aliases, non-ASCII case distinctness, parent segments, reserved device basenames, separator normalization, NotBuilt entries and non-UTF-8 paths

findings.description: unused_temp_path promised a nonexistent path without proving it; PID reuse after an interrupted run could return a stale node
findings.disposition: fixed in the pre-Phase-4 review pass: the helper verifies absence with symlink_metadata before returning

findings.description: Helper self-tests and timers conflict tests asserted only catch_unwind(...).is_err(), so an unrelated panic satisfied them
findings.disposition: fixed in the pre-Phase-4 review pass: assert_panics_with requires the panic payload to contain the intended message; migrated test_fs, test_diagnostics, timers conflict tests and the new BuiltOutputs self-tests

findings.description: Phase 1's absence migration covered only the compiler crate; 14 negative Path::exists assertions remained in xtask tests
findings.disposition: fixed in the pre-Phase-4 review pass: added xtask/src/test_fs.rs (assert_path_missing/assert_regular_file/assert_directory with a dangling-symlink regression) and migrated bench_history and benchmark_workspace call sites

findings.description: Build-system glue selectors matched path.contains("_moth/js/glue/"), so a glue module emitted under an unexpected parent directory satisfied an assertion about the glue directory
findings.disposition: fixed in the Phase 4 closeout: glue predicates use a shared GLUE_MODULE_PREFIX with starts_with, matching the already-anchored provider, canvas and runtime selectors, with a self-test proving a nested vendor/_moth/js/glue path does not match
